description: Each recursive solver step preserves the allowed-variable invariant and decreases either the allowed-set cardinality or, with that set fixed, the total term-node count.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.recursive_progress.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (V : Finset ℕ) (P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Problem L)
  (hv : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Supported V P) :
  (∀ (Q : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Problem L),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.classify P =
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Action.keep Q →
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Supported V Q ∧
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.problemSize Q <
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.problemSize P) ∧
    ∀ (x : ℕ) (t : L.Term ℕ) (R : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Problem L),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.classify P =
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Action.eliminate x t R →
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Supported (V.erase x)
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.substProblem
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.single x t) R) ∧
          (V.erase x).card < V.card
